Every export carries one of three tiers; Extension and Scaffold are frozen and Unstable has no promise.
Tier membership and definitions live in the reference index.
The tiers are a target discipline because cairn is still 0.x.

Lead-in saying the vocabulary terms carry one meaning across the docs.
A concept is a content kind the adapter declares: a directory of markdown files plus a fieldset.
The adapter is the one object cairn.config.ts builds and the engine reads.
Render is the createRenderer function that the admin preview and every public page call.
A seam is a documented extension point carrying a stability tier and a compatibility promise.
An island is a Svelte component hydrated inside static output and declared through an IslandRegistry.
A save waits on the holding branch until a deliberate Publish copies it to the default branch.
The manifest is the committed JSON index with one row per entry.
The admin and the delivery layer read the manifest instead of crawling the repository.
A build regenerates and verifies the manifest.
A save patches the manifest one changed row.
A role is a site-defined name and a capability is one of none, editor, or owner.
Every role resolves to a capability that the engine gates check.
Pointers from the extend track to shared reference and admin pages.
